name: proxmox-auth-failure
description: Proxmox VE failed logins from syslog (header stripped). Covers the daemon's own line, logged by pvedaemon for every realm ("authentication failure; rhost=... user=user@realm msg=..."), and the pam_unix line for the proxmox-ve-auth PAM service (Linux PAM realm, logged under the tag IPCC.xs). The remote address is unwrapped from ::ffff:a.b.c.d.
pattern: ^(?:authentication failure; rhost=(?:::ffff:)?(?<rhost>[0-9a-fA-F:.]{2,45}) user=(?<user>\S{1,128}) msg=(?<reason>.{0,512})|pam_unix\(proxmox-ve-auth:auth\): authentication failure; logname=\S{0,64} uid=\d{1,10} euid=\d{1,10} tty=\S{0,64} ruser=\S{0,64} rhost=(?:(?:::ffff:)?(?<pam_rhost>[0-9a-fA-F:.]{2,45}))? {1,4}user=(?<pam_user>\S{1,128}))$

test_samples.description: pvedaemon: failed web UI / API login (syslog tag pvedaemon, header stripped)
test_samples.input: authentication failure; rhost=::ffff:192.168.1.130 user=root@pam msg=Authentication failure

test_samples.description: pvedaemon: unknown user in the built-in PVE realm
test_samples.input: authentication failure; rhost=::ffff:203.0.113.45 user=admin@pve msg=no such user ('admin@pve')

test_samples.description: pam_unix failure for the Linux PAM realm (syslog tag IPCC.xs, header stripped)
test_samples.input: pam_unix(proxmox-ve-auth:auth): authentication failure; logname= uid=0 euid=0 tty= ruser= rhost=::ffff:192.168.1.130  user=root

test_samples.description: sshd's pam_unix failure is not a Proxmox login
test_samples.input: pam_unix(sshd:auth): authentication failure; logname= uid=0 euid=0 tty=ssh ruser= rhost=203.0.113.9  user=root
